text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, I'm on my way to training as usual, when…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Pfft, hehehe!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I catch Meisho Doto laughing.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh, th-this isn't what it looks like! This is, um…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: According to her story, a laundry mishap has coated the reverse side of her clothes with lint balls.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: S-so, it feels a little prickly to wear and k-kinda… tickles!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I p-plan to buy some new clothes tomorrow, so this will have to do for today!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, if she can't concentrate, it might make training more difficult.
choice_data_list: I'll call off training so you can use the rest of today to go shopping.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh?! B-but, this won't affect my running. I'll be f—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Hehehe!
choice_data_list: Attempt to power through today's training.
Err on the safe side and take the day off.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-yay! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'll work really hard since you listened to my selfish request!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: …Pfft, hehehe!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: S-stop it! Laughing means I'm losing my concentration… I have to give this my very all!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: …Hehehe!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: What do we have here? You're in quite the high spirits, Doto! But you can't out spirit me!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff… I think I need a little break…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eek! I feel all itch-itchy!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Is there something bothering her?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite the setbacks, Meisho Doto manages to power through training!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Phew… I'm glad this is working out. I'm finally used to the feel!
choice_data_list: It looked like you were having a rough time.
It looked like you were having a rough time.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh, no, no… this is all my fault to begin with, so I can't complain.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Considering that, I feel like I got in a lot more exercise than usual.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I guess everything was all right in the end… hehe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today's session seems to have contributed to Meisho Doto's growth after all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff… Hehehe!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'm a-all right. I'm sure the ticklish feeling will go away with the right amount of concentration!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hyah?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oof, owie ow…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's lost a lot of her ability to concentrate. If we go on like this, she could get injured.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's definitely best to give it a rest for today.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: B-but…
choice_data_list: In exchange, let's give tomorrow double the effort.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Oh! O-okay. Let's do that!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Understood. So, I'll go buy new clothes today.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ummmm…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She goes off to shop for new clothes, and the next day, we return to our regular training schedule.
